code_prompt_defaults.object_description: a split right-triangle diagram with a shared altitude, visible side or angle measurements, and one marked target side
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract: Return one JSON object with keys "answer" and "annotation".
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract_answer_only: Return one JSON object with key "answer".
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {annotation_keys}; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] for that keyed target/support segment endpoint or angle witness
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint: set "answer" to the target side length as a number rounded to one decimal place
